title: Zesty Silky Venezuelan Lentil Pilaf
description: A nutty and silky Venezuelan dish featuring puy-lentils, yuzu-cure, and ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients, this pilaf is a show-off dish for any occasion. It combines the warmth of cumin and coriander with the brightness of yuzu.
instructions: Rinse the puy lentils and drain well.
Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the ground cumin and ground coriander and cook for 1 minute.
Add the puy lentils, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the yuzu juice and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and garnish with chopped fresh cilantro.
